_comment: Type-checks this package's own test/** - the package's main program only includes src/**. Run by the package's 'typecheck' script. The loosened flags live in the shared package-test profile. The 'paths' below are test-only: the integration tests drive real tilemap and physics packages, which publish 'exports' pointing at dist/**, so they are mapped to source like the engine. TypeScript replaces an inherited 'paths' object wholesale rather than merging it, so the engine entries from tsconfig.json are repeated here.
